world.description: a pencil logistics and supply network

world.label: Pencil Supply Network
world.summary: Specialists turn timber and graphite into pencils that are delivered to a shop and bought by customers.

actions.description: Harvest logs from the managed forest.
Mine graphite ore from the graphite mine.
Process graphite ore into pencil graphite.
Make pencils from boards and graphite.
Carry pencils from one stockholder to another.
Sell pencils from the shop to customers.

mechanics.rationale: The forester harvests one log from the named managed forest into the forester's stock.

checks.label: the forester is a forester
the managed forest has a log

limits: Harvesting cannot proceed without a log in the named forest.
tests: A forester may harvest when the named forest has at least one log; one log leaves the forest and enters the forester's stock.
A non-forester or a forest with no logs is refused.
semantic_bindings: forest is the managed forest named by the action.
A harvested log is recorded as inventory.logs.

mechanics.rationale: The timber miller consumes one log to produce one board.

checks.label: the worker is a timber miller
the timber mill has a log

limits: One board is made per available log.
tests: A timber miller with a log consumes one log and gains one board.
A worker with no log or the wrong role is refused.
semantic_bindings: Logs and boards are recorded in the timber mill's inventory.

mechanics.rationale: The graphite miner extracts one unit of ore from the named graphite mine into the miner's stock.

checks.label: the worker is a graphite miner
the graphite mine has ore

limits: Mining cannot proceed without ore in the named mine.
tests: A graphite miner may mine when the named mine has ore; one unit leaves the mine and enters the miner's stock.
A non-miner or a mine without ore is refused.
semantic_bindings: mine is the graphite mine named by the action.
Mined material is recorded as inventory.graphite_ore.

mechanics.rationale: The graphite processor converts one unit of ore in its stock into one unit of pencil graphite.

checks.label: the worker is a graphite processor
the graphite works has ore

limits: One unit of graphite is made per available unit of ore.
tests: A graphite processor with ore consumes one unit of ore and gains one unit of graphite.
A worker with no ore or the wrong role is refused.
semantic_bindings: Ore and processed graphite are recorded in the graphite works' inventory.

mechanics.rationale: The pencil maker uses one board and one unit of graphite to make one pencil.

checks.label: the worker is a pencil maker
the pencil maker has a board
the pencil maker has graphite

limits: Making a pencil requires one board and one unit of graphite.
tests: A pencil maker with both inputs consumes one of each and gains one pencil.
A missing input or the wrong role prevents production.
semantic_bindings: Boards, graphite, and pencils are recorded in the pencil maker's inventory.

mechanics.rationale: The carrier transfers one pencil from the named source stockholder to the named recipient stockholder.

checks.label: the worker is a carrier
the source has a pencil
the source and recipient are different stockholders

limits: The transfer moves one pencil and requires a distinct recipient with inventory.
tests: A carrier can move one pencil from a stocked source to a different stockholder.
A source without a pencil, identical source and recipient, or wrong role is refused.
semantic_bindings: source and to are the stockholders named by the action.
Pencil transfers subtract from the source and add to the recipient.

mechanics.rationale: The shopkeeper sells one available pencil to a customer with outstanding pencil demand.

checks.label: the worker is a shopkeeper
the pencil shop has a pencil
the customer wants a pencil

limits: A sale requires one shop pencil and at least one unit of customer demand.
tests: A shopkeeper can sell one pencil when the shop has stock and the customer has demand.
Insufficient stock, no demand, or the wrong role is refused.
semantic_bindings: Shop stock and customer pencil holdings are inventory.pencils.

processes.rationale: Managed forests regrow logs and graphite mines replenish ore, keeping both named extraction sources available over time.

checks.label: this is the managed forest
this is the graphite mine

processes.rationale: The supply network replenishes the inputs held at each specialist's workplace, allowing each represented production step to operate regularly without inventing an unrepresented transfer action.
Customer demand returns after sales so the shop can continue serving customers indefinitely.

checks.label: customers have no waiting pencil demand

readout.title: How coordination slowed (the four mechanisms of the Waltzman paper)
readout.summary: The forester, graphite miner, graphite works, timber mill, pencil maker, carrier, and pencil shop repeatedly moved materials through the pencil supply chain. Customers’ demand fell to zero, was restored, and the pencil shop continued selling pencils.
